title: Pipeline smoke test — delete me
excerpt: Internal dry-run draft to verify Hermes can insert SAMPA news drafts. Safe to delete.
body_html:
This is an automated draft-only smoke test for the SAMPA news pipeline. It should never be published.

Source: internal test.

key_points.content: SAMPA draft pipeline smoke tests insert posts with status draft only and must not auto-publish.
Editors should delete pipeline smoke-test drafts after verifying they appear under Josh in the editor list.
